Short title and Commencement

ACT V OF 1995
ACT V OF 1995
SINDH (POULTRY VACCINE CENTRE) ACT, 1995
An Act to provide for the
establishment of a Poultry Vaccine Centre in the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 27th September, 1995]
No.PAS/Legis-B-9/95, dated
27-9-1995.--The Sindh (Poultry Vaccine Centre) Bill, 1995 having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 14th June, 1995 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 7th August, 1995 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
CHAPTER--I
PRELIMINARY
1. Short title and Commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh (Poultry Vaccine Centre) Act, 1995.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Definitions

CHAPTER--I
PRELIMINARY
2. Definitions.---In this Act, unless there is anything repugnant
in the subject or context--
(a) "Board' means the Board
constituted under section 5;
(b) "Chairman" means
the Chairman of the Board;
(c) "Fund" means the
Fund of the Centre;
(d) "Government" means
the Government of Sindh;
(e) "Member" means a
member of the Board;
(f) "Prescribed" means
prescribed by rules or regulations;
(g) "Regulations" means
regulations made under this Act;
(h) "Rules" means rules
made under this Act.

Establishment of the Centre

CHAPTER--II
ESTABLISHMENT OF THE CENTRE
3. Establishment of the Centre.---(1) As soon as may be after the
commencement of this Act Government may by a Notification in the Official
Gazette establish in accordance with the provisions of this Act a Centre to be
known as the Sindh Poultry Vaccine Centre.
(2) The Centre shall be a body
corporate, having perpetual succession and common seal, with power, subject to
the provisions of this Act to acquire, hold and dispose of the property both
movable, and immovable, and shall by the said name, sue and be sued.
(3) The Headquarter of the Centre
shall be at Karachi.
(4) The Centre may establish
regional Offices at such places as it may consider expedient.

Administration of the affairs of the Centre

CHAPTER--II

4. Administration of the affairs of the Centre.---(1) Subject to
the other provisions of this Act, the general direction and administration of
the Centre and its affairs shall vest in the Board which may exercise all
powers and do all acts and things which may be exercised or done by the Centre.
(2) The Board in discharging its
functions shall act on sound principles of production of Poultry Vaccines and
act on commercial considerations and shall be guided by such directions as Government
may, from time to time give.
(3) If a question arises whether
any matter is a matter of policy or not the decision of Government shall be
final.

5. Constitution of the Board.--(1) The Board shall consist of--
(i) Secretary, Fisheries and
Livestock Department
Chairman
(ii) Director-General,
Livestock and Fisheries Department
Official Member
(iii) Deputy Secretary (Tech) or
Section Officer (Tech) Fisheries and Livestock Department as nominated by the
Secretary of the Department.
Official Member
(iv) Director, Poultry
Production and Research Sindh, Karachi.
Official Member
(v) Director, Poultry Vaccine
Production Centre.
Official Member
(vi) The Chairman of the
Department of Physiology University of Karachi or his nominee.
Non-Official Member
(vii) The Chief Executive of
the K & N's Breeding Farms, Karachi.
Non-Official Member
(viii) The Chairman of the
Pakistan Poultry Association Sindh Zone
Non-Official Member
(2) The Director, Poultry Vaccine
Centre shall also be the Secretary of the Board.
(3) The Chairman may co-opt any
person- as a member for a particular purpose or a specified period
(4) A member shall hold office at
the pleasure of the Chairman.
(5) A member may by writing under
his hand addressed to the Chairman resign his office.
(6) The Centre may allow such
remuneration to the non-official member as it may determine with the approval
of the Board.
(7) No act or proceedings of the
Board shall be invalid merely on the ground of the existence of any vacancy in
or any defect in the constitution of the Board.

CHAPTER--III
POWERS AND DUTIES OF THE CENTRE AND COMMITTEES
8. Functions of the Centre.--The Centre shall--
(a) accelerate production of
Poultry Vaccines and shall be responsible for planning and promoting projects
in this behalf;
(b) undertake scientific and
technological research for the improvement of quality of vaccines and
production of new vaccines and utilization of such vaccines and publish results
of such research for general information;
(c) plan and implement training
programmes in the field of poultry vaccines;
(d) devise easy methods of
administration of vaccines;
(e) promote joint ventures
specially with foreign investors for the improvement of quality of poultry
vaccines;
(f) take such steps as may be
necessary or conducive to the attainment of its Objects.

12. Fund.--(1) The Centre shall be a self-financing body and it
shall maintain a separate fund known as Poultry Vaccine Centre Fund.
(2) The fund shall consist of:
(a) Sale proceeds of poultry
vaccines, other poultry biological products, or any other property of the
Centre;
(b) Grants made by or loans
obtained from Government.
(c) Grants made by any person or
body.
(d) Loans obtained from any
source with the sanction of Government
(e) Profit or interest on the
deposits of its surplus Funds;
(f) All other sums receivable by
the Centre.
(3) The amount credited in the
fund shall be deposited in any scheduled Bank approved by the Board.
(4) The fund shall be utilized
for carrying out the purposes of this Act, including the payment of salaries
and other remuneration payable under this Act.
(5) The Centre may invest its
surplus fund in any security of the Federal Government or Provincial Government
or any other security or scheme approved by Government.
